topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Ran across something today in the drizzle, a time capsule, and not just any, but one I apparently slipped into the ground years back. The city’s usual gray skyline couldn’t dampen the surprise. Inside, old photos, a few coins, and a letter from me to me. The letter’s got a tone, young and hopeful, the kind that makes you smile. It’s funny, reading what I’ve written, like catching up with an old friend. Sometimes, the past throws you a bone, and today, I got mine. Bottle of bourbon's calling my name, and maybe a toast to the years that passed and the ones still to come.
